title: Transition function for the doubling machine
statement: The transition function assigns an action to each state of the doubling machine, the symbol under its input head (or blank), and the symbol under its single work-tape head (or blank), according to the specified state-dependent rules. The action records the head movements, any work-tape write or output, and the next state or halting decision.
